einzeiler: Inside the decade-long investigation and murder trial in the Faith Hedgepeth case.
kurzfassung: Following a verdict in the 2012 murder of University of North Carolina student Faith Hedgepeth, journalists and legal experts discuss the decade-long investigation. Investigators faced thousands of potential leads before genetic genealogy finally pointed to Miguel Salguero Olivares. Despite a lack of a clear motive, a jury unanimously found the defendant guilty on all counts.
stichpunkte: Faith Hedgepeth was a 19-year-old student at the University of North Carolina found murdered in her off-campus apartment in 2012.
Investigators interviewed nearly 1,800 people over the years as the case went cold.
Genetic genealogy eventually led authorities to suspect Miguel Salguero Olivares.
DNA evidence recovered from a Bacardi bottle at the crime scene served as a crucial piece of physical evidence.
The defense pointed to inconsistencies surrounding the victim's roommate, Karina Rosario, who discovered the body.
A recorded jailhouse video call featuring a deceased friend reduced the defendant to tears during the trial.
Jurors deliberated for over a day after initially split votes before reaching a unanimous guilty verdict.
The victim's family and community remain without a clear explanation regarding the killer's motive.

clips.hook: A promising student with ambitions to serve her community
clips.text: The student maintained an exceptional academic record and secured a scholarship, planning to attend medical school in order to return and practice healthcare among her indigenous community.

clips.hook: An unexpected emotional breakdown in the courtroom
clips.text: The defendant wept openly in front of the jury after viewing footage of a departed companion expressing affection during a past conversation.

clips.hook: Navigating division and doubt inside the jury room
clips.text: Initial deliberations revealed a fractured panel where several members required significant persuasion before overcoming lingering uncertainties about guilt.

beschreibung:
Shocking evidence, emotional testimony and lingering questions. Ryan Smith and Pat LaLama give us a glimpse inside the Faith Hedgepeth murder trial.
